newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.7 bln for Tuesday, May 6.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.7 bln for Tuesday, May 6.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, May 6 are expected to total $1.7 billion in 44 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.5 billion in 20 sales, with a $486 million San Antonio, Texas, deal through PaineWebber Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $194 million are on the schedule. A $53 million Hamilton County, Tenn., deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $68 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday depending on market conditions.
